These are the leaders of the days; they are the reckoning of the laws of the luminaries, which Uriel showed me — he who is the leader of all their reckonings.
እሉ፡ ʾəllu መርሕተ፡ marḥata መዋዕልት፡ mawāʿəlt ኮኑ፡ konu ኆለቆሙ፡ ḫolaqomu ለሕገገ፡ la-ḥəgaga ብርሃናት፡ bərhānāt ዘአርአየኒ፡ zaʾarʾayanī ኦሪኤል፡ ʾUrʾēl ዘውእቱ፡ zawəʾətu መርሐ፡ marḥa ኵሉ፡ kwəlu ኆለቆሙ፡ ḫolaqomu
Notes Verse 6

Closing colophon — Uriel as leader of all reckonings. This verse closes the lunar-treatise (chs 78-79) with a colophon-style attribution: Uriel as the leader (marḥa) of all the reckonings of the laws of the luminaries. The verse restates Uriel's portfolio established at 1 En 72:1 (the opening of the Astronomical Book) and reaffirmed at 1 En 75:3 + 82:7. The closing colophon establishes a literary inclusio bracketing the Astronomical Book's astronomical-and-calendrical content within Uriel's cosmic-administrative-authority. See central entry uriel-angel-over-luminaries-1-enoch-72-79-82-cross-corpus.

Chapter 80

1 Enoch 80 — The oracle of cosmic disorder in the days of the sinners

1
And at that time Uriel the angel said to me: Behold, Enoch, I have shown you all, and I have disclosed all to you, that you might see this sun and this moon and the leaders of the stars of heaven, and all who order them — their works and their dominions and their times.
And this is the second Parable concerning those who deny the name of the dwelling of the holy ones and the Lord of Spirits.
ወበጊዜሁ፡ wa-ba-gizēhu ይቤለኒ፡ yəbēlanī ኦሪኤል፡ ʾUrʾēl መልአክ፡ malʾak ናሁ፡ nāhu አርአይኩከ፡ ʾarʾayku-ka ሄኖክ፡ Henok ኵሎ፡ kwəlo ወከሠትኩ፡ wa-kaśatku ለከ፡ la-ka ኵሎ፡ kwəlo ከመ፡ kama ትርአይ፡ tərʾay ዘንተ፡ zanta ፀሐይ፡ ḍaḥay ወዘንተ፡ wa-zanta ወርኀ፡ warḫa ወመራኅያኒሆሙ፡ wa-marāḫəyānihomu ለከዋክብት፡ la-kawākəbt ሰማይ፡ samāy ወኵሎ፡ wa-kwəlo ዘያስተራኩም፡ zayāstarākum ኪያሆሙ፡ kiyāhomu ግብሮሙ፡ gəbromu ወመንግሥቶሙ፡ wa-mangəśtomu ወጊዜሆሙ፡ wa-gizēhomu
2
And in the days of the sinners the years shall be shortened, and the seed of grain shall be late in their lands and in their fields; and everything upon the earth shall be afflicted, and the rains of the earth shall be withheld, and the seed of their days shall not come up upon their lands.
And into the heaven they shall not ascend, And on the earth they shall not come: Such shall be the lot of the sinners Who have denied the name of the Lord of Spirits, Who are thus preserved for the day of suffering and tribulation.
ወበመዋዕለ፡ wa-ba-mawāʿəla ኃጥኣን፡ ḫāṭəʾān ዓመታት፡ ʿāmatāt ይሠራዕ፡ yəśarrāʿ ወእክለ፡ wa-ʾəkla ዘርዕ፡ zarʿ ይሠቀል፡ yəśaqqal በምድሮሙ፡ ba-mədromu ወበግብሮሙ፡ wa-ba-gəbromu ወኵሉ፡ wa-kwəlu ላዕለ፡ lāʿla ምድር፡ mədr ይሠቀል፡ yəśaqqal ወአዝመተ፡ wa-ʾazmata ምድር፡ mədr ይትዐጽው፡ yətʿaḍḍəw ወዘርእ፡ wa-zarʾə ዘዕለቶሙ፡ za-ʿəlatomu ኢይትከሥት፡ ʾiyətkaśśat ላዕለ፡ lāʿla ምድሮሙ፡ mədromu
Notes Verse 2

THE COSMIC-DISORDER ORACLE — opening of the foundational Second-Temple-period cosmic-signs eschatological pericope. 'In the days of the sinners the years shall be shortened.' This verse opens one of the foundational Second-Temple-period texts of the cosmic-signs eschatological tradition — the framework that runs through Joel 2:30-31 (Hebrew Bible substrate), Mt 24:29 + Mk 13:24-25 + Lk 21:25-26 (Synoptic Olivet Discourse), Rev 6:12-13 (sixth-seal opening), Sura 81:1-14 al-Takwīr (Qur'anic rolling-up-of-the-sun), and Sura 54:1 inshiqāq al-qamar (Qur'anic moon-splitting).

The wickedness-of-humanity correlation. A distinctive feature of the 1 En 80 framework is the explicit correlation between the cosmic-disorder and human-wickedness: the cosmic-bodies depart from their natural-cosmic-order in the days of the sinners. The cosmic-disorder is concurrent with — and in some sense caused by — the human-sinfulness of the end-times. The framework is one of the most-influential Second-Temple-period eschatological-cosmographic frameworks.

See central entry cosmic-disorder-1-enoch-80-end-times-cross-corpus-joel-nt-revelation-qur-an for the systematic treatment. The existing NT cosmic-signs cluster entry cosmic-signs-cluster-joel-2-mark-13-acts-2-luke-21-rev-6-cross-corpus is extended in this Editor pass to include the ENO-WOH-80 refIds.

3
And every fruit-bearing blossom on the earth shall be withheld; the tree shall withhold its fruit, and the vine shall withhold its fruit; and much seed shall be sown but shall come to nothing.
On that day Mine Elect One shall sit on the throne of glory And shall try their works, And their places of rest shall be innumerable. And their souls shall grow strong within them when they see Mine elect ones, And those who have called upon My glorious name:
ወይትዐጾ፡ wa-yətʿaḍḍo ኵሉ፡ kwəlu ዘለፍሬ፡ zala-fərē ጽጌ፡ ṣəgē በላዕለ፡ ba-lāʿla ምድር፡ mədr ወዕፅ፡ wa-ʿəḍ ይዕወር፡ yəʿwər ፍሬሁ፡ fərēhu ወወይን፡ wa-wayn ይትዐጾ፡ yətʿaḍḍo ፍሬሁ፡ fərēhu ወብዙኅ፡ wa-bəzuḫ ዘርዕ፡ zarʾə ይሰየብ፡ yəsayyab ወይትከሐድ፡ wa-yətkaḥad
4
And the moon shall change her laws and shall not appear in her appointed times.
Then will I cause Mine Elect One to dwell among them. And I will transform the heaven and make it an eternal blessing and light:
ወወርኅ፡ wa-warḫ ይትዌላጥ፡ yətwēllāṭ ሕገጊሁ፡ ḥəgagihu ወኢይትከሠት፡ wa-ʾiyətkaśśat በበ፡ baba ጊዜሁ፡ gizēhu
Notes Verse 4

The moon-departing-from-her-order — direct cosmic-signs language. This verse contains the direct cosmic-signs statement: the moon alters her order and does not appear in her appointed time. The framework parallels Mt 24:29 ('the moon shall not give her light' / hē selēnē ou dōsei to phengos autēs), Mk 13:24-25 (the same Markan formulation), Joel 2:31 ('the moon to blood' / ha-yārēaḥ lĕ-dām), and Sura 54:1 inshiqāq al-qamar (the moon-splitting). The 1 En 80 framework provides one of the OLDEST stratigraphic-layers of this entire cosmic-signs cluster, given the Aramaic-DSS dating of the Astronomical Book to the late 3rd c. BCE.

5
And in those days there shall appear in heaven a great drought upon the eastern horizon of heaven, before the station of the stars.
And I will transform the earth and make it a blessing: And I will cause Mine elect ones to dwell upon it: But the sinners and evil-doers shall not set foot thereon.
ወበእማንቱ፡ wa-ba-ʾəmāntu መዋዕል፡ mawāʿəl ይትከሠት፡ yətkaśśat በሰማይ፡ ba-samāy ወይመጽእ፡ wa-yəmaṣṣəʾ ዐቢይ፡ ʿabəy ድርቅ፡ dərq ላዕለ፡ lāʿla ድንኅ፡ dənḫ ምሥራቅ፡ məśrāq ሰማይ፡ samāy ቅድሜሁ፡ qədmēhu ለመንበረ፡ la-manbara ከዋክብት፡ kawākəbt
6
And many chiefs of the host of the stars shall transgress the order of the command, and shall change their courses and their tasks, and shall not appear in their appointed times — the times prescribed for them.
For I have provided and satisfied with peace My righteous ones And have caused them to dwell before Me: But for the sinners there is judgement impending with Me, So that I shall destroy them from the face of the earth.
ወብዙኃን፡ wa-bəzuḫān መርሐ፡ marḥa ሐራ፡ ḥarā ለከዋክብት፡ la-kawākəbt ይስሕቱ፡ yəsḥətu ሥርዐተ፡ śərʿata ዘትእዛዝ፡ zatəʾəzāz ወይትዌላጡ፡ wa-yətwēllāṭu ፍኖቶሙ፡ fənotomu ወግብሮሙ፡ wa-gəbromu ወኢይትከሠቱ፡ wa-ʾiyətkaśśatu በበ፡ baba ጊዜሆሙ፡ gizēhomu ሎሙ፡ lomu ዘሥርዕተ፡ zaśərʿta ሎሙ፡ lomu
Notes Verse 6

The stars transgressing their orbits — direct cosmic-signs language. This verse contains the direct cosmic-signs statement: the stars transgress their orbits and shall not appear in their appointed times. The framework parallels Mt 24:29 (hoi asteres pesountai apo tou ouranou 'the stars shall fall from heaven'), Rev 6:13 (hoi asteres tou ouranou epesan eis tēn gēn 'the stars of heaven fell to the earth'), Rev 12:4 (the dragon's tail sweeping a third of the stars), and Isa 13:10 (the stars of the heavens not giving their light). The 1 En 80:6 'transgress the order of the command' framing extends the broader Second-Temple-Jewish fallen-stars / rebellious-luminary tradition (cross-corpus to 1 En 18:13-16 + 21:1-6 — the fallen stars in their place-of-judgement; Jude 6 + 2 Pet 2:4).

7
And all the laws of the stars shall be shut against the sinners; and they shall lead astray the minds of those who dwell upon the earth, and they shall be regarded by them as gods.
ወኵሉ፡ wa-kwəlu ሕገገ፡ ḥəgaga ለከዋክብት፡ la-kawākəbt ይትዐፀዉ፡ yətʿaḍḍəw ላዕለ፡ lāʿla ኃጥኣን፡ ḫāṭəʾān ወያስተዐሰዉ፡ wa-yāstaʿassəw መንፈሰ፡ manfasa እምኔሆሙ፡ ʾəmənnehomu ለእለ፡ la-ʾəlla ቤት፡ bēt ይነብሩ፡ yənabbəru በላዕሌሆሙ፡ ba-lāʿlēhomu ወያስሕቱ፡ wa-yāsḥətu ኪያሆሙ፡ kiyāhomu ወይትገበሩ፡ wa-yətgabbaru አማልክት፡ ʾamālekt
Notes Verse 7

Humans mistake the stars for gods — the primal idolatry-frame. This verse names the cosmic-disorder's spiritual-consequence: the disordered-stars lead humanity astray, with humans worshipping the stars as gods. The framework is a Second-Temple-Jewish development of the primal-idolatry tradition: the host-of-heaven worship that the Hebrew Bible repeatedly denounces. Cross-corpus to Deut 4:19 ('lest you lift up your eyes to heaven, and when you see the sun and the moon and the stars, all the host of heaven, you be drawn away and bow down to them and serve them'), Jer 7:18 + 8:2 + 19:13 (the host-of-heaven idolatry under Judah's last kings), 2 Kings 23:5 (the mazzālôt-worshippers purged by Josiah's reform), Wisd 13:1-2 (the wise-of-the-Gentiles taking the cosmic-bodies for gods), and Acts 7:42-43 (Stephen's speech citing Amos 5:25-27 LXX on the worship of the host-of-heaven). The 1 En 80:7 cosmic-disorder + star-worship combination presents a developed-eschatological extension of the broader Hebrew-Bible host-of-heaven-worship tradition.

8
And evil shall be multiplied upon them, and judgment shall come upon them, unto the destruction of them all.
ወይብዝኅ፡ wa-yəbzəḫ እኩይ፡ ʾəkuy ላዕሌሆሙ፡ lāʿlēhomu ወመቅሠፍት፡ wa-maqśaft ይመጽእ፡ yəmaṣṣəʾ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ lāʿlēhomu ለመጥፋዕተ፡ la-maṭfāʿta ኵሎሙ፡ kwəlomu
Chapter 81

1 Enoch 81 — The heavenly tablets and the seven holy ones' charge to Enoch

1
And he said to me: Enoch, look upon the tablets of heaven, and read what is written upon them, and learn everything in detail.
And there I saw One who had a head of days, And His head was white like wool, And with Him was another being whose countenance had the appearance of a man, And his face was full of graciousness, like one of the holy angels.
ወይቤለኒ፡ wa-yəbēlanī ሄኖክ፡ Henok ነጽር፡ naṣṣər ውስተ፡ wəsta ጽላተ፡ ṣəlāta ሰማይ፡ samāy ወአንብብ፡ wa-ʾanbəb ዘጽሑፍ፡ zaṣəḥuf ላዕሌሆሙ፡ lāʿlēhomu ወአእምሮ፡ wa-ʾaʾəməro ኵሎ፡ kwəlo በበ፡ baba ኪሉ፡ kilu
Notes Verse 1

THE HEAVENLY TABLETS — the cosmic-record of all events past, present, and future. This verse opens one of the foundational Second-Temple-Jewish texts of the heavenly-tablets motif. The Ge'ez ṣəlāta samāy ('tablets of heaven') translates a Second-Temple-Jewish cosmographic-cosmic-record framework that runs across 1 Enoch (1 En 81:1-3 + 93:2 + 103:2 + 106:19 + 107:1), Jubilees (Jub 5:13 + 23:32 + 30:9 + dozens of additional references), and into the Hebrew Bible / Christian-Apocalyptic-NT 'books opened at the judgement' tradition (Dan 7:10; Rev 5:1; Rev 20:12).

The heavenly-tablets are the divinely-inscribed cosmic-record: the catalog of all events past, present, and future, including the deeds of all humans. Enoch's reading-of-the-heavenly-tablets is the cosmographic-revelation that establishes his cosmic-knowledge-of-history. The textual-revelation framework (the cosmic-record as readable-text rather than as purely-cognitive-divine-knowledge) is one of the most-influential Second-Temple-period cosmographic-frameworks.

See central entry heavenly-tablets-1-enoch-81-jubilees-daniel-revelation-cross-corpus. The existing v2.66.0 central entry enoch-as-scribe-mediator-figure-12-jub-4-metatron-cross-corpus is extended in this Editor pass to include the ENO-WOH-81 refIds.

2
And I looked upon all the tablets of heaven, and read all that was written upon them, and understood all; and I read the book of all the deeds of mankind and of all the children of flesh that shall be upon the earth, unto their generations forever.
And I asked the angel who went with me and showed me all the hidden things, concerning that Son of Man, who he was, and whence he was, (and) why he went with the Head of Days? 3. And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Man who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because the Lord of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before the Lord of Spirits in uprightness for ever.
ወነጸርኩ፡ wa-naṣṣarku ኵሎ፡ kwəlo ጽላተ፡ ṣəlāta ሰማይ፡ samāy ወአንበብኩ፡ wa-ʾanbabku ኵሎ፡ kwəlo ዘጽሑፍ፡ zaṣəḥuf ላዕሌሆሙ፡ lāʿlēhomu ወአእመርኩ፡ wa-ʾaʾəmarku ኵሎ፡ kwəlo ወአንበብኩ፡ wa-ʾanbabku መጽሐፈ፡ maṣḥafa ኵሉ፡ kwəlu ግብረ፡ gəbra ሰብእ፡ sabʾ ወኵሉ፡ wa-kwəlu ውሉደ፡ wəluda ሥጋ፡ śəgā እለ፡ ʾəlla ይከውኑ፡ yəkawwənu ላዕለ፡ lāʿla ምድር፡ mədr እስከ፡ ʾəska ለትዉልዶሙ፡ la-təwlədomu ለዓለም፡ la-ʿālam
Notes Verse 2

Enoch reads the heavenly-tablets — the cosmographic-revelation. The verse establishes the cosmographic-revelation framework: Enoch reads the divinely-inscribed cosmic-record of all human-deeds, past and future. The 'book of all the deeds of mankind' framework parallels the Jubilees heavenly-tablets framework (Jub 5:13: 'the judgement of all is ordained and written on the heavenly tablets in righteousness') and anticipates the Rev 20:12 final-judgement framework ('the dead were judged from the things written in the books, according to their deeds'). The cosmographic-revelation establishes Enoch as the cosmic-knowledge-bearer: he has read the cosmic-record and can therefore instruct his children (Methuselah and downstream generations) on the cosmic-eschatological situation.

3
And I blessed the Lord, the King of Glory, who has made all the works of the world; and I gave thanks to the Lord because of his long-suffering toward the children of Adam.
ወባረክዎ፡ wa-bārakəwwo ለእግዚአብሔር፡ la-ʾəgziʾabḥēr ንጉሠ፡ nəguśa ክብር፡ kəbr ዘገብረ፡ zagabra ኵሎ፡ kwəlo ግብረ፡ gəbra ዓለም፡ ʿālam ወአእኮትክዎ፡ wa-ʾaʾəkotku-wwo ለእግዚአብሔር፡ la-ʾəgziʾabḥēr በእንተ፡ ba-ʾənta ትዕግሥቱ፡ təʿgəśtu ላዕለ፡ lāʿla ውሉደ፡ wəluda አዳም፡ ʾAdām
4
And I said in that hour: Blessed is the man who dies righteous and good, against whom no record of unrighteousness has been written, and against whom no day of judgment shall be found.
And this Son of Man whom thou hast seen Shall †raise up† the kings and the mighty from their seats, [And the strong from their thrones] And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners.
ወእቤ፡ wa-ʾəbē በበ፡ baba ጊዜሁ፡ gizēhu ብፁዕ፡ bəḍuʿ ዘውእቱ፡ zawəʾətu ብእሲ፡ bəʾsi ዘይመውት፡ zayəmawwət ጻድቅ፡ ṣādəq ወሠናይ፡ wa-śannāy ዘዘፍርደ፡ zaza-fərda ኢተጽሕፈ፡ ʾitaṣəḥfa ላዕሌሁ፡ lāʿlēhu ወዘዕለተ፡ wa-zaʿəlata ኵነኔ፡ kwənanē ኢተረክበ፡ ʾitarakba
5
And those seven holy ones brought me and set me upon the earth, before the gate of my house; and they said to me: Tell all things to your son Methuselah, and show all your children that no flesh is justified before the Lord, for he is the Creator.
[And he shall put down the kings from their thrones and kingdoms] Because they do not extol and praise Him, Nor humbly acknowledge whence the kingdom was bestowed upon them.
ወእልክቱ፡ wa-ʾəlləktu ሰብዐቱ፡ sabʿatu ቅዱሳን፡ qəddusān አምጽኡኒ፡ ʾamṣəʾuni ወአንበሩኒ፡ wa-ʾanbaru-ni ላዕለ፡ lāʿla ምድር፡ mədr ቅድመ፡ qədma ዐጸዱ፡ ʿaḍadu ለቤትየ፡ la-bētəya ወይቤሉኒ፡ wa-yəbēlu-ni ንግሮሙ፡ nəgəromu ኵሎ፡ kwəlo ለወልድከ፡ la-waldə-ka ማቱሳላ፡ Mātusālā ወአርኢ፡ wa-ʾarʾi ለኵሎሙ፡ la-kwəlomu ውሉድከ፡ wəlud-ka ከመ፡ kama አልቦ፡ ʾalbo ዘያስተበቍዕ፡ zayāstabaqqwəʿ ሥጋ፡ śəgā ቅድሜሁ፡ qədmēhu ለእግዚአብሔር፡ la-ʾəgziʾabḥēr እስመ፡ ʾəsma ፈጣሪ፡ faṭāri ውእቱ፡ wəʾətu
Notes Verse 5

THE SEVEN HOLY ONES — the seven archangels — bring Enoch back to earth. The 'seven holy ones' (sabʿatu qəddusān) at 1 En 81:5 are the seven archangels of the broader 1 Enoch corpus — Uriel, Raphael, Raguel, Michael, Sariel/Saraqael, Gabriel, Remeiel (per the canonical-developed list at 1 En 20:1-8). The seven-archangels serve as the heavenly-administrative-attendants who effect Enoch's translation back-to-earth-temporarily for the one-year-instruction-period preamble to the final assumption.

The one-year-instruction-period. This verse opens the distinctive 1 En 81:5-9 one-year-instruction-period framework: Enoch is returned-to-earth-temporarily for one year to instruct his son Methuselah, then taken-up-permanently to the heavenly-residence (v. 7). The framework provides the developed-form of the Gen 5:24 taking-of-Enoch tradition: the cosmic-translation includes the cosmographic-cosmic-record-revelation (vv. 1-3), the one-year-instruction-period preamble (vv. 5-9), and the final-assumption — not merely the simple bypass-of-death framing of Heb 11:5.

See central entry enoch-final-assumption-one-year-instruction-1-enoch-81-cross-corpus and the bidirectional-extension of seven-archangels-list-1-enoch-20-tob-12-rev-8-cross-corpus (extended to add 1 En 81:5).

6
For one year I will leave you with your children, until you have gained strength again, that you may teach your children, write down for them, and testify to them concerning everything; and tell your children's children also.
And he shall put down the countenance of the strong, And shall fill them with shame. And darkness shall be their dwelling, And worms shall be their bed, And they shall have no hope of rising from their beds, Because they do not extol the name of the Lord of Spirits.
አሐደ፡ ʾaḥada ዓመተ፡ ʿāmata እንኅድግከ፡ ʾənḫədəggə-ka ምስለ፡ məsla ውሉድከ፡ wəlud-ka እስከ፡ ʾəska ታጸንዕ፡ tāṣannəʿ ዳግመ፡ dāgəma ወትምህር፡ wa-təməhər ውሉደከ፡ wəluda-ka ወትጽሕፍ፡ wa-təṣəḥf ሎሙ፡ lomu ወትሰምዕ፡ wa-təsamməʿ ሎሙ፡ lomu ኵሎ፡ kwəlo ወትዜንዎሙ፡ wa-təzēnəwwomu ለውሉደ፡ la-wəluda ውሉድከ፡ wəlud-ka ካዕበ፡ kāʿba
7
And in the second year they shall take you from their midst; and your heart shall be strengthened, for the righteous shall be reckoned with the righteous, and the sinners shall be punished for each of their sins.
And these are they who †judge† the stars of heaven, [And raise their hands against the Most High], †And tread upon the earth and dwell upon it†. And all their deeds manifest unrighteousness, And their power rests upon their riches, And their faith is in the gods which they have made with their hands, And they deny the name of the Lord of Spirits,
ወበአመ፡ wa-ba-ʾama ካልዕ፡ kāləʿ ዓመት፡ ʿāmat ይትነሥኡከ፡ yətnaśśəʾu-ka እምነ፡ ʾəmənna ምድር፡ mədr ቅድሜሆሙ፡ qədmēhomu ወልብከ፡ wa-ləbbə-ka ይጸንዕ፡ yəṣannəʿ እስመ፡ ʾəsma ጻድቃን፡ ṣādəqān ዘጻድቀ፡ zaṣādəqa ኆሊቆሙ፡ ḫolaqomu ይከውን፡ yəkawwən ወኃጥአን፡ wa-ḫāṭəʾān ይትኄሰሱ፡ yətḫēsasu ለበበ፡ laba-ḫāṭiʾatomu ኃጢአቶሙ፡
Notes Verse 7

Enoch's final assumption — the permanent taking-up. This verse states the final-assumption event: in the second year (after the one-year-instruction-period preamble of v. 6), Enoch is taken from the human-community permanently. The 'taking from their midst' framework develops the Gen 5:24 wa-lōʾ ʾēnennû kî lāqaḥ ʾōṯô ʾĕlōhîm ('and he was not, for the Elohim took him') in the Second-Temple-Jewish cosmographic-cosmic-translation register.

The 1 En 81:7 framework is the textual-fountainhead of the Enoch-Metatron tradition that develops through 2 Enoch (Slavonic Enoch, late 1st c. CE; the angelic-summons-to-translation + the heavenly-ascent through the seven heavens) and 3 Enoch (Sefer Hekhalot, c. 5th-6th c. CE; the identification of the cosmic-translated-Enoch with the enthroned-Metatron). See central entries enoch-final-assumption-one-year-instruction-1-enoch-81-cross-corpus and enoch-as-scribe-mediator-figure-12-jub-4-metatron-cross-corpus.

8
And whoever desires righteousness in their times shall accomplish for them every good work, without falsehood and without sin.
And they persecute the houses of His congregations, And the faithful who hang upon the name of the Lord of Spirits.

Chapter 82

1 Enoch 82 — Enoch's instructions to Methuselah and the names of the season-leaders

1
And now, my son Methuselah, I am telling you all this and writing it for you; I have disclosed all to you, and have given you the book concerning all these things.

ወይእዜሰ፡ wa-yəʾəzē-sa ወልድየ፡ waldə-ya ማቱሳላ፡ Mātusālā ኵሎ፡ kwəlo ዘንተ፡ zanta እነግረከ፡ ʾənaggərə-ka ወእጽሕፈከ፡ wa-ʾəṣəḥfa-ka ኵሎ፡ kwəlo ለከ፡ la-ka ከሠትኩ፡ kaśatku ወወሀብኩከ፡ wa-wahabku-ka መጽሐፈ፡ maṣḥafa በእንተ፡ ba-ʾənta ኵሉ፡ kwəlu እሉ፡ ʾəllu

Notes Verse 4

THE BEATITUDE-POLEMIC — Aramaic-PRIMARY witness (4Q211 + 4Q209 frag 28). This verse is the central calendrical-polemic-as-beatitude statement of the Astronomical Book: keeping the right (364-day solar) calendar = righteousness; using the wrong (lunar) calendar = sin. The beatitude-formula (běrīrīn kol ṣaddīqayyāʾ 'blessed are all the righteous') frames the calendrical-choice as a moral-religious choice with eternal consequences.

The verse is preserved in the Aramaic 4Q211 + 4Q209 frag 28 in fuller form than the Ge'ez transmission preserves. The polemical-edge is one of the sharpest in the Second-Temple-period Jewish corpus: the calendar-dispute is framed in beatitude-and-curse register, parallel to the Jubilees 6:32-38 polemic and the broader Qumran-Enochic-Jubilees identity-marker tradition.

See central entry qumran-364-day-solar-calendar-polemic-1-enoch-72-82-jubilees-cross-corpus for the systematic treatment of the calendrical-identity-keystone status of the 364-day solar calendar.

5
And they err concerning them — these four days that are added to the solar year — those who do not reckon them with the dominion of the sun and with the dominion of the stars.
וטעין wě-ṭāʿēn בהון běhōn אלין ʾillēn ארבעת ʾarbaʿat יומיא yōmayyāʾ די dī מסתפין mistappīn לשנת lě-šěnat שמשא šimšāʾ די dī לא lāʾ חשבין ḥāšbīn בהון běhōn עם ʿim מלכות malkūt שמשא šimšāʾ ועם wě-ʿim מלכות malkūt כוכביא kōkěbayyāʾ
Notes Verse 5

The four-epact-days polemic in Aramaic — the sharpest articulation. Aramaic-PRIMARY witness (4Q211). The verse states explicitly the calendrical-error that the polemic targets: the failure to count the four epact-days (the days that bring the schematic 360-day base year to 364) within the dominion of the sun and the stars. The polemic targets the proto-Rabbinic / Pharisaic / Temple-Establishment tradition that did not count these four days as part of the solar calendrical-system. The Aramaic preservation of the polemic in fuller form than the Ge'ez is consistent with the witness-fullness-inversion pattern documented at the per-translation overlay.

6

Notes Verse 6

The righteous-shall-heed-them — the closing polemical articulation. This verse closes the calendrical-polemic section with the righteous-vs-sinners distinction made explicit: the righteous keep the right calendar (counting the four epact-days within the dominion of the sun and stars); the sinners fail to count them. The 'book shall reckon them rightly' invokes the heavenly-tablets framework of 1 En 81: the cosmic-record will preserve the correct calendrical reckoning for the righteous against the sinners' erroneous reckoning. The polemical-cluster of 72:32 + 74:11-12 + 75:1-3 + 82:4-6 forms the foundational textual-articulation of the 364-day-solar-calendar identity-marker in the Astronomical Book.

Notes Verse 11

The four season-leader angel-names — Melkiel, Helemmelek, Meleyal, Narel. The four named season-leaders are the angelic-administrative-leaders of the four 91-day quarters of the 364-day solar year (cf. ch 75). The Ge'ez witness preserves a five-name list (Melkiel, Elmeel, Helemmelek, Meleyal, Narel) where the system expects four; the modern critical reconstruction (Charles 1912; Nickelsburg-VanderKam 2012) identifies the canonical four as Melkiel (first quarter), Helemmelek (second quarter), Meleyal (third quarter), Narel (fourth quarter). The fifth name (Elmeel) is likely a scribal-doublet inflation. The WoH translation preserves the Ge'ez verbatim per the per-verse layered-witness convention.

The theophoric -ʾēl ending follows the standard Hebrew/Aramaic angelological pattern (Michael, Gabriel, Raphael, Uriel, Sariel). The four season-leaders are the next-level-subordinates of Uriel (the overall cosmic-administrative-angel over the luminaries) in the Astronomical Book's angelological hierarchy.

16
In his days there is light upon the earth, and the days lengthen; and the beasts and the herbs spread out over the earth; and day grows longer than day.
በመዋዕሊሁ፡ ba-mawāʿəlihu ይከውን፡ yəkawwən ብርሃን፡ bərhān ላዕለ፡ lāʿla ምድር፡ mədr ወመዋዕልት፡ wa-mawāʿəlt ይነውሑ፡ yənawwəḥu ወአራዊት፡ wa-ʾarāwit ወጥይም፡ wa-ṭəyəm ይትከበቡ፡ yətkababu ላዕለ፡ lāʿla ምድር፡ mədr ወይከውን፡ wa-yəkawwən መዋዕል፡ mawāʿəl ለመዋዕል፡ la-mawāʿəl ይነውሕ፡ yənawwəḥ
17
And these are the names of the leaders who are after him: Berbeel, and Zalabeel, and the third, who is added, whose name is Heleyammamo; and the days of their leading are completed.
ወእሉ፡ wa-ʾəllu ስማቲሆሙ፡ səmātihomu ለመራኅት፡ la-marāḫət እለ፡ ʾəlla ድኅሬሁ፡ dəḫrēhu ቤርቤኤል፡ Bērbēʾēl ወዘላቤኤል፡ wa-Zalābēʾēl ወሣልስ፡ wa-śāləs ዘያትዌሰክ፡ zayātwēsak ዘይሰምዮ፡ zayəsamməyo ሄሌአሞ፡ Hēlēʾamamo ወመዋዕለ፡ wa-mawāʿəla ምራኅቲሆሙ፡ mərāḫətihomu ይትፌጸሙ፡ yətfēṣamu
18
The next leader after him is Helemmelek, whose name they call 'the resplendent light.'
ካልዕ፡ kāləʿ መርሕ፡ marḥ ድኅሬሁ፡ dəḫrēhu ሄለሜሌክ፡ Hēlamamēlek ስሙ፡ səmu ዘጻድቅ፡ zaṣādəq ብርሃን፡ bərhān ይጼውዕዎ፡ yəṣēwwəʿwwo
19
And in the days of his dominion the days lengthen and the night is shortened; and the laws of his dominion bring drought and heat, and the beasts multiply, and the light lengthens, and the night is shortened.
ወመዋዕሊሁ፡ wa-mawāʿəlihu ለመንግሥቱ፡ la-mangəśtu መዋዕልት፡ mawāʿəlt ይነውሑ፡ yənawwəḥu ወሌሊት፡ wa-lēlit የሐጽጽ፡ yaḥaḍḍəḍ ወሕግጋቲሁ፡ wa-ḥəgagāttihu ለመንግሥቱ፡ la-mangəśtu ይከውን፡ yəkawwən ድርቅ፡ dərq ወሞቅ፡ wa-moq ወአራዊት፡ wa-ʾarāwit ይምልኡ፡ yəməllu ወብርሃን፡ wa-bərhān ይነውኅ፡ yənawwəḫ ወሌሊት፡ wa-lēlit ይሕጽጽ፡ yəḥaḍḍəḍ
20
And these are the names of the leaders after him: Gidael, and Keel, and Heel; and the name of the leader who is added after them is Asphael; and the days of his dominion are completed.
ወእሉ፡ wa-ʾəllu ስማቲሆሙ፡ səmātihomu ለመራኅት፡ la-marāḫət ድኅሬሁ፡ dəḫrēhu ጊዳኤል፡ Gidāʾēl ወቄኤል፡ wa-Qēʾēl ወሄኤል፡ wa-Hēʾēl ወስሙ፡ wa-səmu ለመርሐ፡ la-marḥa ድኅሬሆሙ፡ dəḫrēhomu ዘይትዌሰክ፡ zayətwēsak አስፋኤል፡ ʾAsfaʾēl ወመዋዕለ፡ wa-mawāʿəla መንግሥቱ፡ mangəśtu ይትፌጸሙ፡ yətfēṣamu
Notes Verse 20

The Ge'ez ends abruptly mid-pattern — Aramaic 4Q211 preserves continuation beyond Ge'ez. This verse closes the Ge'ez witness of the Astronomical Book at the summer-quarter (Helemmelek) section. The Aramaic 4Q211 fragments preserve a continuation beyond the Ge'ez ending — confirming Milik 1976's hypothesis that the original Aramaic Astronomical Book extended substantially further into autumn/winter quarter-leader material. The witness-fullness-inversion is consistent with the broader pattern documented at the per-translation overlay (aramaic-fuller-than-geez-lunar-tables-4q208-convention): the Aramaic preserves more text than the Ge'ez, suggesting the original Astronomical Book was substantially longer than what the Ge'ez tradition has transmitted.

The Ge'ez of v. 20 closes the chapter abruptly; the surviving 4Q211 Aramaic continuation has not been integrated into the WoH translation surface text (per the per-verse layered-witness convention, the Aramaic-only extra-Ge'ez material would require an appendix-extension; the WoH translation restricts to verses with Ge'ez parallel). The textual-witness situation is documented for the Reviewer's evaluation.

Contents

    Wheel of Heaven is an open, multilingual reading of the ancient world's creation traditions — Raëlian, biblical, Mesopotamian, and others — through a single working hypothesis: that the beings called Elohim were a small advanced human civilization that came here, designed life on Earth, and left a record in the religious texts. The reading runs across twelve ages of the precessional cycle, from the project's beginning twenty-two thousand years ago to the present age of disclosure and into the long future the next Great Year is opening. The site is free, source-aware, and built so the work can be checked.
